expected_outcomes: Identifies an N+1 pattern: one git subprocess (fork/exec plus history walk) per item, up to 300 per render
Proposes at least two options, for example a single `git log --name-only` pass building a path-to-last-commit map, bounded-concurrency workers, or caching results keyed by HEAD sha
States tradeoffs (memory or parse complexity of one big log, concurrency limits and disk contention, cache invalidation)
Says to measure first (time a single git log invocation on this repo, or profile) before choosing, and does not present the 9 seconds as fully explained by inference alone
Does not fabricate benchmark figures as measured facts
